name: PhoneInput
description:
A phone number with its country. The country picker (flag, ISO code, +calling code, search
by any of them) sets how national numbers are read; typing or pasting an international
number ("+64 21 123 4567", "0011 64…") switches it. The value is E.164; the box shows the
number in national or international form once focus leaves, never reformatting under the
caret. libphonenumber-js loads with the first phone control.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, defaultCountry, kind, display, extension, countries, priority, flags, copyable, size, width, placeholder, disabled, readOnly, required, invalid, name, id, onBlur, className, ref, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: PhoneInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: copyable
props.description: A copy button for the E.164 value while it is valid. Default true.

props.name: countries
props.description: Only these countries in the picker.

props.name: defaultCountry
props.description: The country of national numbers until the person picks another: the workspace's own. Default "AU".

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: display
props.description: How the number shows once focus leaves: national "0412 345 678" (default) or international "+61 412 345 678".

props.name: extension
props.description: An extension box for desk phones ("ext. 204"). Default false.

props.name: flags
props.description: Flags in the picker and the box (SVG, lazy). Default true.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid. Pair it with an accessible validation message.

props.name: kind
props.description: Mobile numbers only (placeholder and icon; MobileField and mobileSchema check the type).

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when blur occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when value change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: priority
props.description: Countries listed first in the picker. Default: the default country, then AU and NZ.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: value
props.description: E.164 ("+61412345678"), with ";ext=204" for an extension. While the text cannot be read, the text as typed.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width (R15.6). Default medium.
